parent_objective: design a no-PPO probe that combines source-history pair-group objective with the M1358 bidirectional trajectory anchor
blocked_by: M1358 exports the combined anchor but no update protocol has been specified
supersedes: direct actor update without a pre-registered bidirectional probe design

public_gates: M1359 must not update actor weights
M1359 must not use private holdout
M1359 must preserve actor input contract
M1359 must specify exact-first and M267-first evaluation order

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: specifies how the M1358 combined correct-history and wrong-history anchor should be consumed by one no-PPO probe
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, full replay, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the design routes directly to PPO
stop if the design omits wrong-history branch constraints
stop if the design omits exact-first and M267-first gate order
stop if the design changes actor inputs
fallback_plan: if combined-anchor consumption is underspecified, route to implementation-design repair
if branch-asymmetric constraints are still missing, route to active-set design audit
if the design is complete, route to exactly one no-PPO implementation probe
if cadence trigger fires after the implementation probe, synthesize before local tuning
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1358 exported a valid bidirectional anchor and needs a bounded no-PPO probe design

admission_evidence: M1358 exported a valid combined anchor with required rows 6,10,13,15,16 present
M1357 requires separate correct-history and wrong-history branch constraints
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: design specifies trainable scope and mutation checks
design specifies exact-first and M267-first evaluation order
design routes to exactly one no-PPO implementation probe

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1359 designs intervention-proof machinery and cannot claim anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve M267/M264 wrong-history success-drop rows 6,10,13,15,16 after a later update
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1358 combined anchor built from M1355 correct-history retention rows and M267/M264 wrong-history trajectories.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the later probe improves exact metrics but makes wrong-history rows safe again, classify as proof_washout and synthesize before local coefficient tuning.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A no-PPO bidirectional active-set probe can be specified to consume the M1358 combined anchor and test exact source-history improvement without sacrificing correct-history or wrong-history replay behavior.
success_criteria: design specifies trainable scope and mutation checks
design specifies exact source-history metrics before replay
design routes to exactly one no-PPO implementation probe
no training, PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design omits exact-first or M267-first order
design routes directly to PPO or promotion
training, PPO, replay, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1359 passes as a design milestone only if it specifies a no-PPO bidirectional active-set probe over the M1358 combined anchor while keeping training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, replay execution, and actor-input changes blocked.
